title: A producer brings a library loop into their project

steps.caption: A new project opens on the arrangement, with the starter pattern
Find a loop in the library recorded at another tempo
A new track at the bottom carries the loop at bar 1
Open the clip — it is a tempo-labelled loop, not a one-shot
The tempo, the brace and the transport are untouched
Reload — the new track and its loop are still there
